OVERVIEW: Inspect & display a kext collection's contents according to the
options provided.

USAGE: kmutil inspect <options>

OPTIONS:
  -V, --variant-suffix <variant-suffix>
                          The image suffix to use for the kernel variant.
                          (default: nil)
  -a, --arch <arch>       The architecture to use for the
                          extension(s)/collection(s) specified. (default: nil)
  -z, --no-authorization  Skip approval checks for this action. 
  -v, --verbose           Toggle verbosity. 
  --show-mach-header      Print the mach header(s) in the collection(s). Use
                          with --verbose to show more output. 
  --show-fileset-entries  Print the fileset entries of the mach header(s) in
                          the collection(s). 
  --show-kext-load-addresses
                          Print the load addresses of each kext in the
                          collection(s). 
  --show-kext-uuids       Print the UUIDs of each kext in the collection(s). 
  --show-kernel-uuid      Print the UUID of the kernel in the collection. 
  --show-kernel-uuid-only Print the UUID of the kernel in the collection, and
                          suppress default kext information. 
  --no-header             Don't show the header describing the collection the
                          data came from. 
  --show-prelink-info     Dump the __PRELINK_INFO section(s) of the
                          collection(s). 
  --show-collection-metadata
                          Print the metadata of the collection(s). 
  --show-mach-boot-properties
                          Print derived Mach-O boot properties 
  --show-extension-info   Show extension information. Default if no other
                          options specified. 
  --json                  Print the section layout of the collection(s) as
                          JSON. 
  -p, --bundle-path <bundle-path>
                          Include the bundle specified at this path in the
                          results. Return an error if not found. 
  -b, --bundle-identifier <bundle-identifier>
                          Search for, and/or include this identifier in the
                          results. Return an error if not found. 
  -f, --filter <filter>   Filter results by the given predicate string, which
                          specifies properties in an extension's Info.plist.
                          This is overridden by other arguments for specifying
                          and excluding extensions. 
  -F, --filter-all <filter-all>
                          Filter results by the given predicate string, which
                          specifies properties in an extension's Info.plist.
                          This is not overridden by other arguments for
                          specifying and excluding extensions. 
  --optional-identifier <optional-identifier>
                          Search for, and/or include this identifier in the
                          results, if possible. 
  --elide-identifier <elide-identifier>
                          Do not include this identifier in the results. 
  -B, --boot-path <boot-path>
                          The path to the boot kernel collection. 
  -S, --system-path <system-path>
                          The path to the system kernel collection. 
  -A, --auxiliary-path <auxiliary-path>
                          The path to the auxiliary kernel collection. 
  -M, --allow-missing-collections
                          Recover gracefully, where applicable, if any
                          collections are missing. 
  --no-variant-extension  Don't append the build variant as an extension to the
                          collection path. 
  -h, --help              Show help information.
